resources.string: Add Keiyoushi or another compatible catalog
Browse source catalogs and verify APKs for compatible Android readers. Sipan does not run these extensions. You can open listed websites in Sipan’s separate Source reader.
Paste an HTTPS catalog address or a Mihon/Tachiyomi add-store link.
The catalog reports the expected Keiyoushi signing fingerprint.
This is a third-party catalog. Only add it if you trust the publisher and have checked its signing fingerprint.

Find an extension, source, or language code

Install this APK for a compatible reader. Android will ask you to confirm. Sipan will not run it.

Open the source website in Sipan’s separate reader with ad blocking. No APK is needed to read the website.
Android can allow Sipan to send a verified APK to its installer. If you enable this, come back and tap Verify and install APK again. You can switch it off after installing.
